service.description: Programmatically discover services in package org.moqui.ide.mcp and return them as Google ADK-compatible FunctionTool definitions.
Queries live dynamic MCP services and the ADK LlmAgent registry to serve all available tools.

parameter.name: tools
parameter.description: List of formatted tool definitions for MCP compliance

service.description: Dynamically executes an MCP tool service by name with provided parameter map.

actions.script: if (!serviceName.startsWith("org.moqui.ai.mcp.")) { ec.message.addError("Unauthorized service execution: " + serviceName) return } Map callParams = parameters ?: [:] Map result = ec.service.sync().name(serviceName).parameters(callParams).call() context.putAll(result)
